test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per ministry of Road transport & Highways, National Highways carry _______ of India's total road traffic.
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Highways carry **0.4** of India's total road traffic as per the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways.
 
• National Highways are crucial for the nation's infrastructure, connecting major cities, ports, and economic centers.
 
• These highways are designed to support high-speed vehicular traffic and play a significant role in the movement of goods and passengers across the country.
 
• Despite constituting only about 2% of the total road network, National Highways handle a disproportionate amount of traffic due to their strategic importance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Road Transport & Highways is responsible for the development and maintenance of National Highways.
 
• National Highways are identified by a unique numbering system, which helps in easy navigation and identification.
 
• Development of National Highways is a key focus area under various government initiatives such as Bharatmala Pariyojana, aimed at improving road connectivity and boosting economic growth.
 
• National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) is the nodal agency for the development and management of National Highways.
 
• Regular maintenance and expansion projects are undertaken to ensure the highways remain efficient and safe for travel.
